stories.title: Recruitment Status Schema and Scoring Contract
stories.description: Define canonical schema for clinical trial recruitment status (e.g., RECRUITING, COMPLETED, TERMINATED, ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING) and map each status to a normalized score contribution. Establish contract for downstream consumers in Evaluate Care.

stories.title: Recruitment Status Extraction and Normalization
stories.description: Implement logic to extract recruitment status from ClinicalTrials.gov API responses and normalize values into the defined schema (handling casing, variants, and missing fields).

stories.title: Recruitment Status Scoring Logic
stories.description: Implement scoring algorithm that assigns higher scores to actively recruiting trials and lower scores to completed or terminated trials. Ensure deterministic output and compatibility with broader trial scoring pipeline.

stories.title: Expose Recruitment Status Score via EvaluateCare Facade
stories.description: Integrate recruitment status scoring into Evaluate Care response model and expose it through the evaluate_care_facade for downstream chat/UI consumption.

stories.title: Recruitment Status Unit and Integration Tests
stories.description: Create unit tests for status normalization and scoring logic, and integration tests validating end-to-end flow from ClinicalTrials API ingestion through Evaluate Care facade output.
